description: This PHP source file is part of the TestLink open-source testing management system. It handles displaying and managing test cases assigned to a user within a specific project, including interactions with test plans, execution statuses, and various UI components for test case management.

classes.name: TLSmarty
classes.description: A class for rendering Smarty templates within the TestLink project.

classes.name: tlExtTable
classes.description: A class for creating and managing extended HTML table displays in the UI.

classes.name: tlObjectWithDB
classes.description: Base class providing database table access methods for TestLink objects.

classes.name: testcase
classes.description: A class representing a TestLink test case, providing methods to retrieve test case data and executions.

classes.name: testproject
classes.description: A class for managing test projects within TestLink, including retrieving project info.

classes.name: tlUser
classes.description: A class representing a user within TestLink, including authentication and permission management.

classes.name: testplan
classes.description: A class for managing test plans within TestLink, including platform retrieval.

methods.name: get_date_diff
methods.description: Calculates the difference in days between a given date and the current time.

methods.name: init_args
methods.description: Initializes and returns an object containing parameters received from request/session, used to control page behavior.

methods.name: getColumnsDefinition
methods.description: Defines column structure for the test case display table based on provided test plan and options.

methods.name: initializeGui
methods.description: Sets up the GUI data structure for rendering, including titles, localization, and user information.

methods.name: getStatusGuiCfg
methods.description: Retrieves and configures GUI representations for test execution statuses from system configuration.

methods.name: getQuickExecCfg
methods.description: Provides HTML snippets for quick execution action icons (pass, fail, blocked) tied to status values.
